subject: math

hotspots.label: Factor pair
hotspots.description: A factor pair is two numbers that multiply to the center number — like 3 and 4 for 12.
hotspots.positionHint: The floating multiplication cards arranged around the center, each showing a factor pair.
hotspots.function: Two numbers whose product is the target number.

hotspots.label: Factor list
hotspots.description: The complete factor set is every number that divides the target evenly — for 12 that is 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12.
hotspots.positionHint: The flat list plate at the front of the scene showing the full factor set.
hotspots.function: Lists every factor of the center number.

hotspots.label: Division check
hotspots.description: Each factor divides the center number with no remainder — 12 ÷ 4 = 3 R 0 proves 4 is a factor.
hotspots.positionHint: The small division proof revealed when a factor card is flipped.
hotspots.function: Confirms a number is a factor by even division.

visualStyleNotes: Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A clean center number card with a ring of factor-pair cards around it and a factor list plate at the front. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / molecular-green / grid-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Center card: warm paper white with ink-grey number (roughness ~0.5). Factor-pair cards: slightly smaller warm paper cards with ink text, each carrying a faint violet cast edge. Factor list plate: warm paper with ink text. Mat: soft warm-grey. No emissive channels anywhere — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: factors as a hub-and-spoke diagram — a center number card with its factor-pair cards arranged around it, plus a factor-list plate and division-check cards.

GEOMETRY: Center card (flat rounded plate, ~0.8 × 0.5) showing '12' at origin. Around it, three factor-pair cards (1×12, 2×6, 3×4) float in an arc at radius ~1.2, y ≈ 0.5. Each card sits above a throwaway division-check card (12 ÷ 4 = 3 R 0). A front factor-list plate at y ≈ −0.2 shows '1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12'. A small slider control updates the center number (e.g. to 18 or 24) and rearranges the arc into the new factor pairs.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) center + pair arc; (2) division-check cards; (3) factor-list plate.

CAMERA: head-on from +z frames center hub and arc; labels legible. Budget 6-10k triangles. Named nodes: CenterCard, FactorPair_Each, DivisionCheck_Each, FactorListPlate, NumberSlider_Knob. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
